summary: Iteration 11 — Native VIen Calendar + Reminders + Google-removal fully verified. 6/6 pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_calendar_reminders.py (availability/slots, calendar range with per-day open_slots+appointments, slot subtraction after book, 409 double-book, 400 outside-hours, block-time hides slot, approve/reschedule/complete/no_show lifecycle, cron endpoint 401 without/with wrong token + 200 with valid WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET, notifications.py contains no Google/Apps-Script integration). Also verified out-of-band with a script that send_due_reminders processes past-due pending reminders (delivery_status transitions to sent/failed/prepared, sent_time populated). Frontend Playwright verified staff sidebar 'Calendar' -> /internal/calendar; day header format 'YYYY Mon - DD' ('2026 Sep - 19'); day/week toggle (1 vs 7 cal-day cards); prev/next/today nav; 40 open slots rendered; cal-open-slot opens cal-book-dialog; cal-book-search + cal-book-result returns 10 ROMERO results with DOB in 'YYYY Mon - DD' format; cal-block opens cal-block-dialog with block-start/block-end/block-confirm; Appointments queue dialog for a Confirmed appointment shows appt-reschedule / appt-complete / appt-noshow / appt-cancel testids.

issues: The 'Confirmed: <date>' banner and 'Preferred options' rows display dates as 'Mon, Sep 21 · 12:00 PM' instead of the global 'YYYY Mon - DD' format. Calendar day-headers and Book/Block dialog titles correctly use 'YYYY Mon - DD'. Only minor — server-provided confirmed_display could route through formatDateTime.

action_items: OPTIONAL: unify confirmed_display + preferred-option label rendering in AppointmentQueue dialog to global 'YYYY Mon - DD' format via formatDateTime (currently uses server strings like 'Mon, Sep 21 · 12:30 PM').
critical_code_review_comments: notifications._send_email/_send_sms records outbound_notifications even when 'to' is None/empty (status='prepared') — fine as prepared record, but consider skipping the DB write for null recipients to avoid noise.

cron_appointment_reminders schedules background task but returns immediately; success is not observable from the endpoint. For production visibility consider a synchronous inline path when the queue is small, or writing a cron_runs collection with counts.

server.py get_busy_slots also treats status='completed'/'no_show' as free (only 'confirmed'/'rescheduled' are busy). Correct per spec; ensure future 'rescheduled' → new 'confirmed' transitions properly clear the old slot (currently _slot_taken uses exclude_id=item_id and the record is updated in place — good).
server.py is now ~1642 lines; split into routers (auth/portal/internal/rx/calendar/cron).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all cal-* and appt-* selectors verified, YYYY Mon - DD format present)
